note.en: A Taiwanese term with no single IFRS equivalent; the sources and uses listed in the course await the teacher (T16).

definition.zh-TW: 股東投入超過股票面額的部分，以及其他不是來自營業的權益增加。本課的故事沒有用到。
definition.en: The part of shareholders' contributions above par value, and other increases in equity that do not come from operations. The course story does not use it.
